title: The one Envoy-marked action that produced a flat non-event all game: 'turn your best charm on him (a gamble) (as an Envoy)' on the hunter returned only 'he answers exactly as plainly as before you started', with no visible roll, gain or loss -- every other Envoy-tagged action (Sack Road toll, the hedge-hermit, Herald Corvane, the honour guard's rest-rite) gave a clear win, a clear costed loss, or new content.
